prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut OpenAPI supports multiple specification files in several ways:

- **Multiple generated specifications:** Use **OpenAPI groups** or Micronaut versioning.  
  Source: [Support for Multiple OpenAPI Definitions](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-openapi/issues/225), [Multiple swagger definition](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-openapi/issues/509)

- **Additional existing YAML/JSON files:** Configure `micronaut.openapi.additional.files` with a comma-separated list of file or directory paths. Supported prefixes include `file:`, `classpath:`, and `project:`.  
  Source: [Micronaut OpenAPI guide](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-openapi/6.15.0/guide/)

- **Merge behavior:** `micronaut.openapi.additional.files-merge-mode` supports:
  - `append`: generated elements take precedence
  - `replace`: additional-file elements take precedence  
  The default is `replace`.

- **Multiple-file generation:** A fix for generating from multiple Swagger files was merged in September 2024.  
  Source: [PR #1738](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-openapi/pull/1738)

The supported UI frameworks/views listed are:

- Swagger UI
- ReDoc
- OpenAPI Explorer
- Scalar
- RapiDoc

Source: [OpenApiViewConfig API documentation](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-openapi/latest/api/io/micronaut/openapi/view/OpenApiViewConfig.html)
